description: Determine whether a vehicle needs an FMCSA electronic logging device: takes vehicle type, gross weight, operating radius, interstate status and CDL status, and returns whether the ELD mandate applies, which exemption fits, and why a broker may still require a connected ELD anyway.

airMileRadius.description: Typical operating radius from the home terminal in air miles. Null if unknown.

grossWeightLbs.description: Gross vehicle weight rating, or combined rating when towing, in pounds. Null if unknown.

interstate.description: True if the vehicle crosses state lines or hauls interstate commerce. Null if unknown.

vehicle.description: Vehicle type, e.g. 'sprinter van', 'cargo van', 'box truck', 'pickup truck / hotshot', 'semi truck'.

name: check_eld_requirement
title: Check whether an ELD is required
